body:
🔥 CORE SMP Indonesia 🔥
Welcome to CORE SMP, an Indonesian Minecraft survival server made for players who love adventure, competition, and community!

Explore the world, build your base, fight other players, collect powerful items, and become one of the strongest players on the server. CORE SMP is designed to be fun, active, and competitive for everyone.

✨ Server Features:
⚔️ Competitive Survival Gameplay
💜 Active Indonesian Community
🎁 Crates, Rewards, and Events
🏆 PvP, Duels, and Tournaments
🌍 Random Teleport and Survival Exploration
🛡️ Teams, Economy, and Ranking System
🚀 Regular Updates and Improvements

Whether you enjoy grinding, PvP, teaming up with friends, or building your own empire, CORE SMP has something for you.

Join now and start your journey on CORE SMP Indonesia!
Can you become the strongest player? ⚔️
